evidence_status: public official multilingual texts; attention packet, not a factual verdict

source_family.title: WHO Pandemic Agreement, WHA78.1
source_family.authentic_text_rule: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish texts are equally authentic.

boring_control.label: Primary responsibility
boring_control.english: States bear the primary responsibility for the health and well-being of their peoples.
boring_control.french_gloss: The French says that health and well-being fall first and foremost to States.
boring_control.spanish_gloss: The Spanish says States are the principal parties responsible for health and well-being.
boring_control.why: Different grammar preserves the same assignment of primary responsibility.

residuals.label: Accountability / responsabilité / rendición de cuentas
residuals.spanish_unit: inclusión, transparencia y rendición de cuentas
residuals.ordinary_explanation: French commonly uses responsabilité where English legal/institutional prose uses accountability; this may be standard terminology rather than a policy shift.
residuals.why_preserve: Spanish explicitly encodes account-giving, while French uses the broader responsabilité. The human-facing nuance is worth inspecting without inferring motive or legal divergence.

residuals.label: Who is together?
residuals.french_unit: Communauté internationale – ensemble en toute équité
residuals.ordinary_explanation: Headings are often naturalized rather than translated word-for-word.
residuals.why_preserve: French names the international community as the subject where English and Spanish use world/world-united language. This may be harmless editorial naturalization, but it changes the imagined actor in the heading.

residuals.label: Care workforce scope
residuals.french_unit: Personnels de santé et d’aide à la personne
residuals.spanish_unit: Trabajadores de la salud y asistenciales
residuals.ordinary_explanation: The three languages have different conventional labels for health and social/personal-care workers.
residuals.why_preserve: French makes personal assistance explicit; Spanish uses an adjectival care/support category; English is compact and potentially broader. Worth checking against WHO terminology before reading significance into it.

boss_mechanic.rule: Jared holds one flotsam piece steady to calm each whirlpool.
boss_mechanic.meaning: Preservation is an attention choice, not an evidence upgrade.
boss_mechanic.recurrence: Sunk and preserved pieces may resurface in later rounds, in the same location or new admixtures, with bounded seeded randomness. Recurrence does not count as corroboration.

bridge: same Article 3 principle across three official texts

stop_condition: One official source family; one boring control; no more than three residuals. Stop here and let Jared play/interpret before widening languages.
